title: Poplar project config
description: poplar.json: the config of a Poplar project. Every field is optional.

$schema.description: The path or URL of this schema, for editors.

zipName.description: The name of the built pack: poplar-out/<zipName>/ and poplar-out/<zipName>.zip. It is also the name that /datapack list shows. Default: the project folder name.

namespace.description: The datapack namespace (a-z, 0-9, _ . -). Default: the project folder name.

description.description: The pack description in pack.mcmeta. Any text component: a string, an object such as {"text": "Hi", "color": "green"}, or an array. Default: zipName.

minFormat.description: The oldest data pack format that the pack supports. At least 88 (Minecraft 1.21.9). Default: the format of the Minecraft version that Poplar targets.

maxFormat.description: The newest data pack format that the pack supports. Not less than minFormat. Default: minFormat.

entry.description: The entry file. It must be inside src/. Default: src/main.poplar.

zip.description: Also write poplar-out/<zipName>.zip, with pack.mcmeta at its root. Default: false.
